# Fresh task contract (24 families)
Every question uses conceptId SKILL-GRADE-fresh-0, applied true, format number, no choices. Public text includes exactly one final line `Данные: JSON` containing the input object only. Six to eight genuine data values/events change control flow/results, never a random irrelevant nonce. Level 0/1/2 means Junior/Middle/Senior. Interpretations below must be spelled out in Russian prompt.
- Python Junior: {values:[integers],limit:integer}. Sum values strictly above limit. Middle: same data, generator filter x>limit, consume first matching item if present, sum remainder. Senior: {values,limit}; loop over values: try if x<=limit continue else total+=x; finally total+=1. Return total.
- SQL Junior: {rows:[{g:'a'|'b'|'c',x:integer|null}],limit}. SELECT COALESCE(SUM(x),0) WHERE x>limit. Middle same rows: number of groups with SUM(x)>limit (NULL ignored, all-NULL SUM is NULL so fails). Senior: sum the per-row window SUM(x) OVER(PARTITION BY g), treating NULL window results as zero. (Group sum contributes once for each original row, including NULL rows.)
- HTTP Junior: {chunks:[strings containing A or Б]}; Content-Length of concatenated UTF-8 chunks without compression. Middle: {limit,events:[{window:integer}]}; fixed-window rate limit, buckets start empty, each event accepted if accepted-count for its window < limit, return number of 429. Senior: {version,requests:[integers]}; sequential atomic PATCH If-Match=request value, success iff current version matches, increment version by 1 on success, return final version.
- Algorithms Junior: {values:[integers],target}; linear search, return comparisons until first target inclusive or full length. Middle: {edges:[[u,v]],target}; undirected graph vertices 0..5, return shortest distance from 0 to target, -1 if unreachable. Senior: {capacity,keys:[integers]}; empty LRU cache, return misses.
- TypeScript Junior: {values,limit}; filter x>limit then map x*2 then sum. Middle: {values:[integer|null],fallback}; sum (x??fallback). Senior: {initial,ops:[{kind:'add'|'mul',v:integer}]}; discriminated union reducer, process in order, return final value.
- React Junior: {initial,values:[integers]}; one batched handler queues setCount(count+x) for each x, count is fixed render snapshot, return final count. Middle: {initial,ops:[{kind:'replace'|'add',v:integer}]}; queue setCount(v) or setCount(c=>c+v) in listed order, return final count. Senior: {latest,responses:[{id,value}]}; initial state=0, latestRequestId remains fixed at latest, process responses in order, only matching id applies; return final state.
- CSS Junior: {boxes:[{width,padding,border}]}; all content-box, symmetric padding/border, margin zero, return sum outer widths (not container width). Middle: {tracks:[integers],gap}; fixed pixel grid tracks, return total track widths plus gaps between tracks. Senior: {rules:[{specificity:[id,class,type],value}]}; every rule matches same element/property width; all same author origin/layer, no important, no inline, scopes equal. Later wins tie; return winning px width.
- Accessibility Junior (iteration 2): {elements:[{disabled:boolean,tabindex:0|-1,hidden:boolean,inertAncestor:boolean}]}; eight native buttons, no other barriers. Count sequential Tab reachable buttons: not disabled, not hidden, no inert ancestor, nonnegative tabindex. Iteration 1 had six buttons with only disabled/tabindex; both results retained because evaluation seeds are now development data. Middle: {elements:[{disabled:boolean,tabindex:-1|0|1|2|3}],steps}; same buttons, IDs implicitly 1-based array indices, positive tabindex ascending then tabindex 0 DOM order, stable equal positives; focus initially before first, steps positive Tab presses; if beyond sequence return 0 (focus leaves region). Senior: {elements:[{disabled:boolean,tabindex:0|-1}],current,steps}; all native visible buttons in trapped dialog; current is 1-based index of an enabled tabindex=0 element, steps signed (negative Shift+Tab, positive Tab). Wrap over eligible elements, return target 1-based index. At least one eligible guaranteed.
